###############################################################################
# GENERATED FILE. Do not edit by hand: python tools/generate_school_slots.py
#
# One generic action per school action per slot. Each is a thin wrapper: the gates are
# scripted triggers and the work is a scripted effect, both taking N. type = owncountry
# with no select_trigger, because the court panel drives these from a button that
# supplies an actor and nothing else (see cc_xp_court_actions.txt for why).
###############################################################################


########## School 1 ##########

cc_xp_school_1_endow = {
	type = owncountry
	price = price:cc_xp_school_endow
	ai_tick = never

	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			cc_xp_enabled = yes
			has_variable = cc_xp_school_1_founder
		}
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			cc_xp_school_can_act = { N = 1 }
		}
	}

	effect = {
		scope:actor = { cc_xp_school_do_endow = { N = 1 } }
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = { value = 0 }
	}
}
